_comment: Quip Cloudflare-tunnel cert pins. Each entry is Base64(SHA-256(SPKI DER)) for a CA key. A connection to *.trycloudflare.com passes when any certificate in its evaluated chain matches. The set is the WE1 intermediate that signs trycloudflare.com today plus the roots of the CAs Cloudflare issues edge certificates from (Google Trust Services, Let's Encrypt, SSL.com), so a Cloudflare CA change does not cut the tunnel off. Never pin the leaf. To rotate, see docs/protocol.md -> 'Updating Pins'. Keep CloudflareCertificatePinningDelegate.hardcodedFallback in step (CertPinningTests checks). Users can override locally by dropping a file with the same shape at ~/Documents/quip-cert-pins.json (the iOS app's Documents container).
_checked: 2026-10-13: trycloudflare.com and *.trycloudflare.com share one certificate, chain leaf -> WE1 -> GTS Root R4 (cross-signed by GlobalSign Root CA). Root hashes computed from the macOS system root store.
